projectState.summary: The repo has a Studio Pattern scaffold, GitHub setup notes, and an initial plan for a browser-first local Ollama-powered musical terrarium. Claude's first review was ingested. Current first implementation slice is a rule-based PixiJS/Tone.js terrarium with three musical players. The time model is delayed-now/lookahead, the session model supports meaningful breaks and performances, and the human avatar is a language-driven producer proxy.
